findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 5 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 34 questions numbered 1-34; by section: 5.1 7, 5.1.1 4, 5.1.2 9, 5.1.3 14.

Covers 5.1, 5.1.1, 5.1.2 and the four cases of 5.1.3 in book order: equations and identities, proper and improper fractions, long division, the theorem on equal polynomials, the domain of an identity, the steps of resolution, and short resolutions in each case with the portal's own fractions (none from the unit's examples or exercises). Comparison questions are answered as two-column tables. Every answer was recomputed in Python (sympy, check5.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
